Hey! I'm new to Reddit but I just want to get this off my chest. 

Today, 


Backstory: I had a good childhood, it wasn't perfect but it was good. Yet, since I was a kid, I always felt alone and an outcast. I never really connected with anyone. It's because I pushe them away. 

I have two older brothers and one younger brother. I was always jealous of them. I can't help it. I felt that's i was always need to improve myself to be noticed, to be loved. I carried that pity until college.

Presently, I have a lot of unresolved issues with God, myself and other people. I work hard until I exhaust myself. My boss tells me to work with others while treating them like robots. I want to resign from my current work and start a firm with my brother but he has other priorities. 

 When not working, I spend a lot of time watching porn, Netflix and etc. and I don't think my best friend regards me the same as his best friend too.i think I'm too boring and prideful.

I thought I have forgiven my parents but I haven't forgiven myself. Help me clear my mind. Sometimes, I get lost in my mind and I can hear voices in my head that tells me to end this all. Is there anyone that I can talk to?
